visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black clay pot sits on a recessed table burner, steam rising from a thick brown bubbling soup as a hand wearing a black heat-resistant glove stirs it with a stainless steel ladle. Surroundings include plates of noodles and mushrooms on a wooden table. (2) A blurred shot reveals the restaurant interior with multiple customers seated at round wooden tables under bright warm indoor lighting with red wall panels. (3) A close-up shows the ladle lifting a spoonful of the thick, rich soup, followed by a metal container pouring glowing red-hot charcoal into the table's heating well. (4) Meat pieces are lifted from the pot, and clear rice wine is poured from a brown glass bottle into the bubbling broth filled with green scallions. (5) A montage of ingredients being added or prepared: raw shrimp being poured from a black tray, red crabs full of golden roe being broken apart, and thinly sliced marbled beef and pork being held on plates and then swished in the hot soup. (6) Side dishes like peeled chestnuts, grey bamboo charcoal balls, and baby corn are added to the pot using shell-shaped bowls. (7) A close-up displays crispy fried ginger duck pieces with sliced garlic and chili, followed by a bowl of rice topped with braised meat and ginger. (8) The camera pans through the spacious, air-conditioned restaurant interior showing empty round tables, and then cuts to an outdoor parking lot at dusk with several cars parked. (9) The final shot shows the bubbling pot again before cutting to a large outdoor illuminated vertical sign at night featuring the restaurant name.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a continuous, low-frequency bubbling and sizzling sound of the hotpot broth. A male narrator speaks with high energy and a friendly, fast-paced delivery. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a clear 4/4 drum beat and synth melodies at approximately 124 BPM. (2) A sharp metallic clink and percussive thud are heard as charcoal is dropped into the table burner. The narrator continues describing the soup quality with rising intonation. (3) A distinct liquid pouring sound occurs as rice wine is added to the pot, exhibiting mid-range frequency splashes. The BGM remains steady in volume, serving as an energetic floor. (4) Frequent high-frequency 'whoosh' sound effects are used as transitions between visual cuts of different ingredients. The narrator's speech rate remains consistently high, matching the fast editing pace. (5) Minor clattering of ceramic plates and metal chopsticks is audible under the narration as food is presented and dipped. The restaurant's ambient chatter is barely perceptible in the background. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's enthusiastic sign-off, accompanied by a final swelling of the synth music before a hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional restaurant review for 'Ding Wei Charcoal Ginger Duck' in Kaohsiung. It utilizes a fast-paced sensory montage to highlight the variety and quality of ingredients (duck, seafood, premium meats) and the traditional charcoal cooking method to entice food enthusiasts. It concludes by showing practical amenities like parking and air conditioning to lower the barrier for visitors.
